Humanoid Robots Showcase Martial Arts Skills in Performance

Humanoid robots demonstrated martial arts techniques in a performance that has gained significant online attention, with a video of the event going viral. The robots received a 'Golden Buzzer' during their appearance on America's Got Talent. Separately, humanoid robots were also featured in a 'fight night' event in Shanghai.
